name: dodo
description: Todo app that keeps a record: see, add, start and complete todos, and get your weekly summary.

interface.longDescription:
DoDo (dodo.day) is a todo app that keeps a record of what you've done. Connect it to ChatGPT and ChatGPT can see today's todos, add new ones, mark the one it's working on, and complete them when the work is done.

Unfinished todos carry over with a D+N count of how many days they've been open, and the weekly summary returns the week's completed, postponed, dropped and remaining tasks with focus time, handy for standups and weekly reports.

Requires a free dodo.day account.
defaultPrompt: Add "write release notes" to my DoDo for tomorrow.
Summarize my week from DoDo for my weekly report.
